title: 第五章 至尊功法心剑诀第六章 帝境之上的功法
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
雷霸脸色一下变的难看了起来，但是他又拿安妙菱没办法。
因为此刻起，安妙菱是宗门的希望。
最后他只能看向莫问天。
莫问天也是一阵头疼，怎么就被秦天迷上了，颜值真就这么重要吗？
就在这时一道呼喊声传来。
“宗主，不好了！”
“有好多妖族在往昆仑赶来。”
莫问天闻言神色一变。
肯定是之前天地异象，吸引到了妖族的注意。
所以它们派妖在附近潜伏，刚好察觉到了安妙菱觉醒上古血脉。
她这种上古血脉对妖兽来说，不亚于稀世珍宝。
因为它们吞噬之后，可以提升自己血脉。
“走我们去看看。”
说完莫问天带着一众峰主往山门方向飞去。
宗门外妖族越来越多。
莫问天刚来到宗门口不久。
就看到一只两米高的白虎飞奔而来。
“白虎妖皇来我昆仑剑派有何贵干？”
哈哈哈！
“你要识趣的话，就把血脉觉醒者交出来。”

“不然的话，就别怪我血洗你们昆仑剑派。”白虎妖皇威胁道。
“笑话！”
“就凭你？灭我昆仑剑派？”莫问天一脸的不屑。
白虎妖皇是半圣二重，和他同阶，所以他丝毫不惧。
“我一个人确实不太够，但是加上青鹏妖皇呢？”
“再过五分钟它就来了，你还有五分钟的考虑时间。”
听到还有一个妖皇，莫问天脸上表情凝重了起来。
“秦天，你带着安妙菱先躲一下。”
“咦！人呢？”
刚他还看到秦天就在他后面，再一看不见了？
莫问天又看向了不远处的安妙菱，“你师傅呢？”
“不知道。”
她也是才发现师傅不见得。
竟能在莫问天和自己旁边无声无息的消失。
她陷入沉思当中。
宗门外十里处，青鹏妖皇正带着手下四大妖王往昆仑剑派奔去。
突然他猛的一下停住了。
content_en:
Lei Ba's face suddenly turned ugly, but there was nothing he could do against An Miaoling.
Because from now on, An Miaoling is the hope of the sect.
In the end, he could only look at Mo Wentian.
Mo Wentian also had a headache. Why was he obsessed with Qin Tian? Is appearance really so important?
Just then a shout came.
"Sect Master, it's not good!"
"There are many monsters coming to Kunlun."
Mo Wentian's expression changed when he heard this.
It must have been the previous vision of heaven and earth that attracted the attention of the demon clan.
So they sent demons to lurk nearby, and they happened to notice An Miaoling awakening her ancient bloodline.
Her ancient bloodline is no less than a rare treasure to monsters.
Because after they devour it, they can improve their own bloodline.
"Let's go take a look."
After speaking, Mo Wentian led a group of peak masters and flew towards the mountain gate.
There are more and more demon clans outside the sect.
Mo Wentian had just arrived at the sect gate not long ago.
I saw a two-meter-tall white tiger flying towards me.
"What does the White Tiger Demon Emperor do to our Kunlun Sword Sect?"
Hahaha!
"If you want to be wise, hand over the person who has awakened his bloodline."
"Otherwise, don't blame me for bloodbathing your Kunlun Sword Sect." The White Tiger Demon King threatened.
"Joke!"
"Just you? Destroy my Kunlun Sword Sect?" Mo Wentian looked disdainful.
The White Tiger Demon King is a second level semi-saint, at the same level as him, so he is not afraid at all.
"It's true that I alone am not enough, but what about the Qingpeng Demon Emperor?"
"It's coming in five minutes, and you have five minutes to think about it."
When he heard that there was another Demon King, Mo Wentian's face became serious.
"Qin Tian, take An Miaoling and hide for a while."
"Hey! Where are the people?"
Just now he saw Qin Tian behind him, but now he couldn't see him anymore?
Mo Wentian looked at An Miaoling who was not far away, "Where is your master?"
"I don't know."
She also just realized that the master was not there.
He was able to disappear silently next to Mo Wentian and himself.
She was lost in thought.
Ten miles outside the sect, the Qingpeng Demon King was running toward the Kunlun Sword Sect with his four demon kings.
Suddenly he stopped abruptly.
